mapper.sql:
WHERE b.board_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND b.board_type_cd = 1404 AND ( b.board_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.board_description_edt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S a WHERE a.board_sq = b.board_sq AND a.answer_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S a WHERE a.board_sq = b.board_sq AND a.answer_is_deleted_yn = 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_BOARD_M b LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON b.user_sq = u.user_sq

SELECT b.board_sq AS sq, b.user_sq AS userSq, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nm AS userNm, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, b.board_ttl AS ttl, b.board_description_edt AS description, b.board_type_cd AS boardTypeCd, b.board_view_cnt AS viewCnt, b.board_comment_cnt AS commentCnt, b.board_recommend_cnt AS recommendCnt, b.board_created_at_dtm AS createdAt, b.board_is_secret_yn = 'Y' AS secret, 'BOARD' AS mainType, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S a WHERE a.board_sq = b.board_sq AND a.answer_is_deleted_yn = 'N') AS answerCnt FROM TBL_BOARD_M b LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON b.user_sq = u.user_sq ORDER BY b.board_sq
u.user_id u.user_nickname b.board_ttl b.board_view_cnt answerCnt b.board_created_at_dtm b.board_created_at_dtm ${sortOrder} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
